description: Retrieves scan progress or sanitized findings for a CookieRisk scan ID. Findings can include the visible banner provider and controls, CookieRisk score, pre-consent tracking status, tag or service classifications, browser-recorded initiator hosts, and consent signals. Page settings and scan-wide network signals are separate. A request in a tracking category alone is not confirmation. Unknown, incomplete, and failed scans do not establish absence of tracking. Accept and reject behavior is outside the scan scope.

scanId.description: The identifier of a CookieRisk quickscan.

name: get_quickscan_result
title: Read a CookieRisk quickscan result
